_note: The three 'What we do' bands on the home page. Every sentence traces to Tom's questionnaire answers of 3 Oct 2026 (hours, WhatsApp, all solid, genuine watches, source and make to order, no online sales, UK next-day delivery, scrap rates 94%/75%, photo ID, repairs and soldering) or to a verified review. Images are the shop's own (assets/SOURCES.md). Each band's 'faqs' are short; the full list is content/faq.json.

items.title:
Buy it, sell it,
*swap it.*
items.alt: Royal Mint Britannia one ounce gold bar sealed in its card
paragraphs: Everything in the case is solid gold or solid silver, and every watch is a genuine pre-owned branded watch we can verify before you buy. Nothing is sold online: enquire about a piece and the sale is arranged with the shop, over the counter or by next-day delivery anywhere in the UK.

Selling works the other way round, on the same counter. We buy gold, silver and other precious metals, jewellery in any condition and pre-owned watches. Scrap gold is bought at 94% of the live spot price and silver at 75%; wearable and desirable pieces are worth more than their metal. Bring photo ID.

faqs.q: How do I buy something I have seen?
faqs.a: Enquire about it by the form, phone or WhatsApp. We confirm it is still in, agree the price, and you collect from the shop or we send it next-day, UK only.
Bring it in, or send a photo and a rough weight first. It goes on the scale in front of you and you get a price while you wait. Bring photo ID.
Yes. Put the value of gold or a watch you already own towards something else in the shop, and we will work out the difference.

cta2.label: Get a price for your gold

items.title:
Not in the case?
*We will find it.*
items.alt: Gold fancy-link chain set with stones
paragraphs: If the piece you want is not in the case, tell us what you are after and we will source it. If it does not exist yet, we can make it to order.
Tell us what you have in mind: the piece, the metal, the size, a photo if you have one. We come back with what is possible and a price.

faqs.q: Can you source a piece for me?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us the piece you are looking for and we will source it.

faqs.q: Do you make pieces to order?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us what you have in mind and we come back with what is possible and a price.

items.title:
Broken?
*Bring it in.*
items.alt: Heavy gold bracelet of engraved links with a box clasp
paragraphs: Jewellery repairs and soldering are done in the shop. Bring the piece in, or send a photo first, and you get a straight answer on what it needs and what it costs.

quote.text: I had my jewellery repaired here they were so helpful and explained everything clearly for me it took less than a week and I was very impressed
quote.name: Janice Skudder

faqs.a: Jewellery repairs and soldering, done in the shop.

faqs.q: How much does a repair cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the piece. Bring it in or send a photo and we will tell you what it needs and what it costs.
